purpose: To file the prospectus for issuing or offering equity instruments for listing on a stock exchange in a permissible jurisdiction.
who: An unlisted public company or its existing holders.
when: Within a period of seven days after the prospectus has been finalised and filed in the permitted exchange.
steps: Finalise the prospectus for listing on the permitted stock exchange.
File the finalised prospectus in the permitted exchange.
File the prospectus in e-Form LEAP-1 along with the fees within the specified time period.
checklist: Verify the company is an unlisted public company not falling under rule 5.
Verify the company has no partly paid-up instruments.
Ensure compliance with the requirements of the Scheme.
Ensure compliance with conditions specified by the Securities and Exchange Board of India if also listing with a recognised stock exchange in India.
Prepare the prospectus to be filed.
watch: The form must be filed within seven days after the prospectus has been finalised and filed in the permitted exchange.
